mcqs.question: The Next-Generation GST reforms were approved at which meeting and came into effect when?
options: The 56th GST Council meeting; before September 2025
After the 56th GST Council meeting; September 2025
Before the 56th GST Council meeting; after September 2025
mcqs.explanation: The Next-Generation GST reforms were approved at the 56th GST Council meeting and came into effect in September 2025. The tempting second option is incorrect because the reforms did not take effect before September 2025.
